summary.text: Jeff McLaughlin is the Democratic nominee, a former Alabama House member from Guntersville. The Alabama Reflector reports he made his name fighting for campaign finance reform and refusing to take campaign contributions, has little online presence, and had reported no fundraising or spending this year as of July 31.

paragraphs.text: Former member of the Alabama House of Representatives from Guntersville.

sources.title: An Alabama attorney general candidate, under the radar
